create_AffineEmbedding: create an AffineEmbedding module with a linear layer mapping in_channels to out_channels
create_LocalAffineEmbedding: create a LocalAffineEmbedding module that uses an MLP to predict per-sample affine transforms
run_LocalAffineEmbedding_forward: run the LocalAffineEmbedding forward pass to apply learned affine transforms to input tensors
run_LocalAffineEmbedding_embed_params: run embed_params on LocalAffineEmbedding to extract the predicted transformation matrix without applying it
review_affine_embedding_dict: review the affine_embedding_dict registry mapping string keys to AffineEmbedding and LocalAffineEmbedding classes
